set.n: Grass Lake bank robbery: $1,300 in gold and silver never recovered
set.pl: GNIS Grass Lake (village); getaway route and chase ground not placed
pinev: Village-level: GNIS Grass Lake; the getaway route and chase ground are not placed (about 3 km).
set.st: 29 July 1920: robbers held up the Grass Lake bank and killed an undersheriff in the chase. All the loot was recovered except about $1,300 in gold and silver coin; the silver was thought thrown out along the getaway route, and the chase ground was searched except where there was water. No later find reported. Pin is the village point, not the spot itself.
set.t: Trace the 1920 getaway route from the Jackson papers; wet ground along it was never searched. Access: unknown.
